An '''Aurilian sculpture''' was a work of art handcrafted by the citizens of the remote [[City/Legends|township]] of [[Aurilia]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]]. It consisted of four separate sections which came together as one to create the entire sculpture, which resembled the town's insignia. This was meant to symbolize how each citizen of Aurilia was just one piece in a greater whole. A complete set of sculpture pieces were awarded to a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] by [[Whip (Human)|Whip]], [[Quharek]], [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Sarguillo]], and the township's [[Chief/Legends|chief]] [[Engineer/Legends|engineer]]. They were a reward to the spacer for being instrumental in the defeat of Aurilia's greatest enemy, the [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Mellichae]], sometime after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="SWG">{{GalaxiesAED}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Aurilian sculpture appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']]. Its four pieces were originally rewards from several different quests in the original iteration of the village of [[Aurilia]]. When Aurilia was blocked off with the release of the ''New Game Enhancements'' in [[November]] [[2005]], the sculpture pieces became no longer obtainable, and thus very valuable. The sculpture pieces were reintroduced in the "rare loot system" on [[October 7]], [[2010]]. The rare loot system allowed players to loot increasingly rare items from any enemy in the game. Despite the game's treatment of the statue as a unique item, multiple players characters could own it simultaneously.<ref name="SWG" />
